annotations.title: UK Planning Constraints: All planning constraints at a point

description: Every published planning and environmental designation at a point in one call: conservation area, listed building (with grade), Article 4, TPO, flood zone, green belt, scheduled monument, World Heritage, parks and gardens, ancient woodland, National Landscape, national park, SSSI, SAC, SPA, Ramsar, nature reserves, battlefields, heritage at risk, heritage coast, AQMA. A few free samples a day, then $0.005 USDC per call via x402.
